listing.name: Crackdown (Crackdown Recompiled)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows package; Linux AppImage experimental Limits: Official launcher/setup expects own Xbox 360 files. Decide one update owner if launcher continues updating. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 ZIP; experimental native Linux x86-64/SteamDeck AppImage, glibc2.31+, Vulkan. Linux has no broad real-hardware validation claim. Original data: Own original, unupdated Crackdown Xbox 360 retail disc, title 4D5307DC, as ISO or extracted folder. Default.xex must be 14,270,464 bytes with SHA-256 7AAA7A8920D1C3C737E58CF583DEBAFE6013BE0A96BEC3EC136E5DE7E3377E5A. Upstream launcher verifies executable and required files; $SystemUpdate is unnecessary. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
